# 1287 "./dpdefs/upstream/csprogsdefs.qc"
float(float skel, float bonenum, string g1, string g2, string g3, string g4, string g5, string g6) example_skel_findbonegroup =
{
 local string bonename;
 while (bonenum >= 0)
 {
  bonename = skel_get_bonename(skel, bonenum);
  if (bonename == g1) return 1;
  if (bonename == g2) return 2;
  if (bonename == g3) return 3;
  if (bonename == g4) return 4;
  if (bonename == g5) return 5;
  if (bonename == g6) return 6;
  bonenum = skel_get_boneparent(skel, bonenum);
 }
 return 0;
};

void() example_skel_player_setup =
{
 self.skeletonindex = skel_create(self.modelindex);
};


void(float animmodelindex, float framegroup, float framegroupstarttime) example_skel_player_update_begin =
{

 self.frame = framegroup;
 self.frame2 = 0;
 self.frame3 = 0;
 self.frame4 = 0;
 self.frame1time = framegroupstarttime;
 self.frame2time = 0;
 self.frame3time = 0;
 self.frame4time = 0;
 self.lerpfrac = 0;
 self.lerpfrac3 = 0;
 self.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 skel_build(self.skeletonindex, self, animmodelindex, 0, 0, 100000);
};

void(float animmodelindex, float framegroup, float framegroupstarttime, float blendalpha, string groupbonename, string excludegroupname1, string excludegroupname2) example_skel_player_update_applyoverride =
{
 local float bonenum;
 local float numbones;
 self.frame = framegroup;
 self.frame2 = 0;
 self.frame3 = 0;
 self.frame4 = 0;
 self.frame1time = framegroupstarttime;
 self.frame2time = 0;
 self.frame3time = 0;
 self.frame4time = 0;
 self.lerpfrac = 0;
 self.lerpfrac3 = 0;
 self.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 bonenum = 0;
 numbones = skel_get_numbones(self.skeletonindex);
 while (bonenum < numbones)
 {
  if (example_skel_findbonegroup(self.skeletonindex, bonenum, groupbonename, excludegroupname1, excludegroupname2, "", "", "") == 1)
   skel_build(self.skeletonindex, self, animmodelindex, 1 - blendalpha, bonenum, bonenum + 1);
  bonenum = bonenum + 1;
 }
};

void(vector eyetarget, string bonename) example_skel_player_update_eyetarget =
{
 local float bonenum;
 local vector ang;
 local vector oldforward, oldright, oldup;
 local vector relforward, relright, relup, relorg;
 local vector boneforward, boneright, boneup, boneorg;
 local vector parentforward, parentright, parentup, parentorg;
 local vector u, v;
 local vector modeleyetarget;
 bonenum = skel_find_bone(self.skeletonindex, bonename) - 1;
 if (bonenum < 0)
  return;
 oldforward = v_forward;
 oldright = v_right;
 oldup = v_up;
 v = eyetarget - self.origin;
 modeleyetarget_x = v * v_forward;
 modeleyetarget_y = 0-v * v_right;
 modeleyetarget_z = v * v_up;


 relorg = skel_get_bonerel(self.skeletonindex, bonenum);
 relforward = v_forward;
 relright = v_right;
 relup = v_up;
 boneorg = skel_get_boneabs(self.skeletonindex, bonenum);
 boneforward = v_forward;
 boneright = v_right;
 boneup = v_up;
 parentorg = skel_get_boneabs(self.skeletonindex, skel_get_boneparent(self.skeletonindex, bonenum));
 parentforward = v_forward;
 parentright = v_right;
 parentup = v_up;

 u = modeleyetarget - boneorg;

 v_x = u * parentforward;
 v_y = u * parentright;
 v_z = u * parentup;
 ang = vectoangles2(v, relup);
 ang_x = 0 - ang_x;
 makevectors(ang);

 skel_set_bone(self.skeletonindex, bonenum, relorg);

 v_forward = oldforward;
 v_right = oldright;
 v_up = oldup;
};


void() example_skel_player_delete =
{
 skel_delete(self.skeletonindex);
 self.skeletonindex = 0;
};

 const float true = 1;

[[eraseable]]
float InterpretBoolean(string input)
{
 switch (strtolower(input))
 {
  case "yes":
  case "true":
  case "on":
   return true;

  case "no":
  case "false":
  case "off":
   return false;

  default: return ((stof(input)) != 0);
 }
}

[[eraseable]]
float randombit(float bits)
{
 if (!(bits & (bits - 1)))
  return bits;

 float r = random();
 float b = 0;
 float n = 0;

 for (float f = 1; f <= bits; f *= 2)
 {
  if (bits & f)
  {
   ++n;
   r *= n;
   if (r <= 1) b = f;
   else r = (r - 1) / (n - 1);
  }
 }
 return b;
}

[[eraseable]]
float randombits(float bits, float k, float error_return)
{
 float r = 0;
 while (k > 0 && bits != r)
 {
  r += randombit(bits - r);
  --k;
 }
 if (error_return)
  if (k > 0) return -1;

 return r;
}

 OP_SET,
 OP_MIN,
 OP_MAX,
 OP_PLUS,
 OP_MINUS
};

[[eraseable]]
float GiveBit(entity e, .float fld, float bit, float op, float val)
{
 float v0 = (e.(fld) & bit);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) |= bit;
   else e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
  case OP_PLUS:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) |= bit;
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   if (val <= 0) e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
 }
 float v1 = (e.(fld) & bit);
 return v0 != v1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float GiveValue(entity e, .float fld, float op, float val)
{
 float v0 = e.(fld);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   e.(fld) = val;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
   e.(fld) = max(e.(fld), val);
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   e.(fld) = min(e.(fld), val);
   break;
  case OP_PLUS:
   e.(fld) += val;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   e.(fld) -= val;
   break;
 }
 float v1 = e.(fld);
 return v0 != v1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float days_up_to_date(float Y, float M, float D)
{
 float years = (M <= 2) ? Y - 1 : Y;

 float leap_days = floor(years / 4) - floor(years / 100) + floor(years / 400);


 float months = (M <= 2) ? (M + 9) : (M - 3);
 float leftover_days = (M <= 2) ? (M + 5) : floor(0.58 * M - 1.1);

 float month_days = 30 * months + leftover_days;

 return 365 * years + month_days + D + leap_days;
}

[[eraseable]]
string strftime_s()
{
 string date = strftime(false, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S");
 float i, seconds = 0;
 i =0; float Y = stof(substring(date, i, 4));
 i+=5; float M = stof(substring(date, i, 2));
 i+=3; float D = stof(substring(date, i, 2));

 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2)) * 60 * 60;
 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2)) * 60;
 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2));





 float days_since_epoch = days_up_to_date(Y, M, D) - 719469;

 float hundreds_of_seconds = days_since_epoch * 24 * 6 * 6;
 hundreds_of_seconds += floor(seconds / 100);


 string seconds_str = ftos(seconds % 100);
 if ((seconds % 100) < 10)
  seconds_str = strcat("0", seconds_str);

 return strcat(ftos(hundreds_of_seconds), seconds_str);
}



[[eraseable]]
string seconds_tostring(float seconds)
{
 float negative = false;
 if (seconds < 0)
 {
  negative = true;
  seconds = -seconds;
  if (floor(seconds) != seconds)
   seconds += 1;
 }
 float minutes = floor(seconds / 60);
 seconds -= minutes * 60;
 if (negative)
  return sprintf("-%d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
 return sprintf("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
}





[[eraseable]]
string clockedtime_tostring(float tm, float hundredths, float compact)
{
 if (tm < 0)
 {
  if (compact)
   return strcat("0.0", hundredths ? "0" : "");
  else
   return strcat("0:00.0", hundredths ? "0" : "");
 }
 float acc = hundredths ? 6000 : 600;
 tm = floor(tm + 0.5);
 float minutes = floor(tm / acc);
 float tm_without_minutes = tm - minutes * acc;

 string s = ftos(acc * 10 + tm_without_minutes);
 if (!compact || minutes > 0)
  return strcat(ftos(minutes), ":", substring(s, 1, 2), ".", substring(s, 3, hundredths ? 2 : 1));

 float ofs = 2, digits = 1;
 if (tm_without_minutes >= 10 * (hundredths ? 100 : 10))
 {
  ofs = 1;
  digits = 2;
 }
 return strcat(substring(s, ofs, digits), ".", substring(s, 3, hundredths ? 2 : 1));

}




[[eraseable]]
string format_time(float seconds)
{
 seconds = floor(seconds + 0.5);
 float days = floor(seconds / 864000);
 seconds -= days * 864000;
 float hours = floor(seconds / 36000);
 seconds -= hours * 36000;
 float minutes = floor(seconds / 600);
 seconds -= minutes * 600;
 if (days > 0) return sprintf(_("%d days, %02d:%02d:%02d"), days, hours, minutes, seconds);
 else return sprintf(_("%02d:%02d:%02d"), hours, minutes, seconds);
}

[[eraseable]]
string swapwords(string str, float i, float j)
{
 float n;
 string s1, s2, s3, s4, s5;
 float si, ei, sj, ej, s0, en;
 n = tokenizebyseparator(str, " ");
 si = argv_start_index(i);
 sj = argv_start_index(j);
 ei = argv_end_index(i);
 ej = argv_end_index(j);
 s0 = argv_start_index(0);
 en = argv_end_index(n - 1);
 s1 = substring_range(str, s0, si);
 s2 = substring_range(str, si, ei);
 s3 = substring_range(str, ei, sj);
 s4 = substring_range(str, sj, ej);
 s5 = substring_range(str, ej, en);
 return strcat(s1, s4, s3, s2, s5);
}

[[eraseable]]
string shufflewords(string str)
{
 _shufflewords_str = str;

 shuffle(n, _shufflewords_swapfunc, (0, world));
 str = _shufflewords_str;
 _shufflewords_str = nil;
 return str;
}

[[eraseable]]
string unescape(string in)
{
 in = strzone(in);

 float len = strlen(in);
 string str = "";
 for (float i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  string s = substring(in, i, 1);
  if (s == "\\")
  {
   s = substring(in, i + 1, 1);
   if (s == "n") str = strcat(str, "\n");
   else if (s == "\\") str = strcat(str, "\\");
   else str = strcat(str, substring(in, i, 2));
   ++i;
   continue;
  }
  str = strcat(str, s);
 }
 strunzone(in);
 return str;
}

[[eraseable]]
float isInvisibleString(string s)
{
 s = strdecolorize(s);
 float utf8 = cvar("utf8_enable");
 for (float i = 0, n = strlen(s); i < n; ++i)
 {
  float c = str2chr(s, i);
  switch (c)
  {
   case 0:
   case 32:
    break;
   case 192:
    if (!utf8) break;
    return false;
   case 0xE000:
   case 0xE00A:
   case 0xE0A0:
   case 0xE020:
   case 0x00A0:
   case 0x180E:
   case 0x2000:
   case 0x2001:
   case 0x2002:
   case 0x2003:
   case 0x2004:
   case 0x2005:
   case 0x2006:
   case 0x2007:
   case 0x2008:
   case 0x2009:
   case 0x200A:
   case 0x200B:
   case 0x202F:
   case 0x205F:
   case 0x3000:
   case 0xFEFF:
   case 0xFFA0:
   case 0x3164:
    if (utf8) break;
   default:
    return false;
  }
 }
 return true;
}

[[eraseable]]
float vercmp_recursive(string v1, string v2)
{
 float dot1 = strstrofs(v1, ".", 0);
 float dot2 = strstrofs(v2, ".", 0);
 string s1 = (dot1 == -1) ? v1 : substring(v1, 0, dot1);
 string s2 = (dot2 == -1) ? v2 : substring(v2, 0, dot2);

 float r;
 r = stof(s1) - stof(s2);
 if (r != 0) return r;

 r = strcasecmp(s1, s2);
 if (r != 0) return r;

 if (dot1 == -1) return (dot2 == -1) ? 0 : -1;
 else return (dot2 == -1) ? 1 : vercmp_recursive(substring(v1, dot1 + 1, 999), substring(v2, dot2 + 1, 999));
}

[[eraseable]]
float vercmp(string v1, string v2)
{
 if (strcasecmp(v1, v2) == 0) return 0;


 if (v1 == "git") return 1;
 if (v2 == "git") return -1;

 return vercmp_recursive(v1, v2);
}

[[eraseable]]
float isValidColorCodeValue(string theText, float cc_len, float tag_start)
{
 if (cc_len == 2)
  return (strstrofs(DIGITS, (substring(theText, tag_start + 1, 1)), 0) >= 0);
 if (cc_len == 5)
  return ((strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 2, 1)), 0) >= 0)
   && (strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 3, 1)), 0) >= 0)
   && (strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 4, 1)), 0) >= 0));
 return false;
}







[[eraseable]]
vector checkColorCode(string theText, float text_len, float pos, float check_at_the_end)
{
 if (text_len == 0)
  text_len = strlen(theText);
 string tag_type = "^";
 float cc_len = 2;
 float tag_len = 1;

 :check_color_tag

 float ofs = cc_len;
 if (!check_at_the_end)
  ofs--;
 for (; ofs >= 1; ofs--)
 {
  if (!(pos >= ofs && text_len >= pos + (cc_len - ofs)))
   continue;
  if(substring(theText, pos - ofs, tag_len) == tag_type)
  {
   if (!isCaretEscaped(theText, pos - ofs) && isValidColorCodeValue(theText, cc_len, pos - ofs))
    return eX * cc_len + eY * ofs;
  }
 }
 if (cc_len == 2)
 {
  tag_type = "^x";
  cc_len = 5;
  tag_len = 2;
  goto check_color_tag;
 }
 return '0 0 0';
}

[[eraseable]]
float rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(vector rgb, float mi, float ma)
{
 if (mi == ma)
 {
  return 0;
 }
 else if (ma == rgb.x)
 {
  if (rgb.y >= rgb.z) return (rgb.y - rgb.z) / (ma - mi);
  else return (rgb.y - rgb.z) / (ma - mi) + 6;
 }
 else if (ma == rgb.y)
 {
  return (rgb.z - rgb.x) / (ma - mi) + 2;
 }
 else
 {
  return (rgb.x - rgb.y) / (ma - mi) + 4;
 }
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(float hue, float mi, float ma)
{
 vector rgb;

 hue -= 6 * floor(hue / 6);



 if (hue <= 1)
 {
  rgb.x = ma;
  rgb.y = hue * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.z = mi;
 }


 else if (hue <= 2)
 {
  rgb.x = (2 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.y = ma;
  rgb.z = mi;
 }
 else if (hue <= 3)
 {
  rgb.x = mi;
  rgb.y = ma;
  rgb.z = (hue - 2) * (ma - mi) + mi;
 }


 else if (hue <= 4)
 {
  rgb.x = mi;
  rgb.y = (4 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.z = ma;
 }
 else if (hue <= 5)
 {
  rgb.x = (hue - 4) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.y = mi;
  rgb.z = ma;
 }


 else
 {
  rgb.x = ma;
  rgb.y = mi;
  rgb.z = (6 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
 }

 return rgb;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector rgb_to_hsv(vector rgb)
{
 float mi, ma;
 vector hsv;

 mi = min(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);
 ma = max(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);

 hsv.x = rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(rgb, mi, ma);
 hsv.z = ma;

 if (ma == 0) hsv.y = 0;
 else hsv.y = 1 - mi / ma;

 return hsv;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hsv_to_rgb(vector hsv)
{
 return hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(hsv.x, hsv.z * (1 - hsv.y), hsv.z);
}

[[eraseable]]
vector rgb_to_hsl(vector rgb)
{
 float mi, ma;
 vector hsl;

 mi = min(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);
 ma = max(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);

 hsl.x = rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(rgb, mi, ma);

 hsl.z = 0.5 * (mi + ma);
 if (mi == ma) hsl.y = 0;
 else if (hsl.z <= 0.5) hsl.y = (ma - mi) / (2 * hsl.z);
 else
  hsl.y = (ma - mi) / (2 - 2 * hsl.z);

 return hsl;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hsl_to_rgb(vector hsl)
{
 float mi, ma, maminusmi;

 if (hsl.z <= 0.5) maminusmi = hsl.y * 2 * hsl.z;
 else maminusmi = hsl.y * (2 - 2 * hsl.z);



 mi = hsl.z - 0.5 * maminusmi;
 ma = hsl.z + 0.5 * maminusmi;

 return hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(hsl.x, mi, ma);
}

  (substring(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (floor(rgb.y * 15 + 0.5)), 1)),
  (substring(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (floor(rgb.z * 15 + 0.5)), 1))
              );
}

[[eraseable]]
string process_time(float outputtype, float seconds)
{
 float tmp_hours = 0, tmp_minutes = 0, tmp_seconds = 0;
 float tmp_years = 0, tmp_weeks = 0, tmp_days = 0;

 tmp_seconds = floor(seconds);

 if (tmp_seconds)
 {
  tmp_minutes = floor(tmp_seconds / 60);

  if (tmp_minutes)
  {
   tmp_seconds -= (tmp_minutes * 60);
   tmp_hours = floor(tmp_minutes / 60);

   if (tmp_hours)
   {
    tmp_minutes -= (tmp_hours * 60);
    tmp_days = floor(tmp_hours / 24);

    if (tmp_days)
    {
     tmp_hours -= (tmp_days * 24);
     tmp_weeks = floor(tmp_days / 7);

     if (tmp_weeks)
     {
      tmp_days -= (tmp_weeks * 7);
      tmp_years = floor(tmp_weeks / 52);
     }
    }
   }
  }
 }

 switch (outputtype)
 {
  case 1: return sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", tmp_hours, tmp_minutes, tmp_seconds);
  case 2:
  {
   string output = "";


   if (tmp_years) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_years, _("CI_ZER^%d years"), _("CI_FIR^%d year"), _("CI_SEC^%d years"), _("CI_THI^%d years"), _("CI_MUL^%d years")));
   if (tmp_weeks) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_weeks, _("CI_ZER^%d weeks"), _("CI_FIR^%d week"), _("CI_SEC^%d weeks"), _("CI_THI^%d weeks"), _("CI_MUL^%d weeks")));
   if (tmp_days) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_days, _("CI_ZER^%d days"), _("CI_FIR^%d day"), _("CI_SEC^%d days"), _("CI_THI^%d days"), _("CI_MUL^%d days")));
   if (tmp_hours) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_hours, _("CI_ZER^%d hours"), _("CI_FIR^%d hour"), _("CI_SEC^%d hours"), _("CI_THI^%d hours"), _("CI_MUL^%d hours")));
   if (tmp_minutes) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_minutes, _("CI_ZER^%d minutes"), _("CI_FIR^%d minute"), _("CI_SEC^%d minutes"), _("CI_THI^%d minutes"), _("CI_MUL^%d minutes")));
   if (tmp_seconds) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_seconds, _("CI_ZER^%d seconds"), _("CI_FIR^%d second"), _("CI_SEC^%d seconds"), _("CI_THI^%d seconds"), _("CI_MUL^%d seconds")));

   if (output == "")
    return count_fill(0, _("CI_ZER^%d seconds"), _("CI_FIR^%d second"), _("CI_SEC^%d seconds"), _("CI_THI^%d seconds"), _("CI_MUL^%d seconds"));
   return output;
  }
  case 3:
  {
   string output = "";

   output = count_fill(tmp_hours, _("CI_ZER^%d hours"), _("CI_FIR^%d hour"), _("CI_SEC^%d hours"), _("CI_THI^%d hours"), _("CI_MUL^%d hours"));

   if (tmp_weeks) tmp_days += (tmp_weeks * 7);
   if (tmp_years) tmp_days += (tmp_years * 365);
   if (tmp_days)
   {
    output = sprintf(
     count_fill(tmp_days, _("CI_ZER^%d days"), _("CI_FIR^%d day"), _("CI_SEC^%d days"), _("CI_THI^%d days"), _("CI_MUL^%d days")),
     ((output != "") ? strcat(", ", output) : ""));
   }

   return output;
  }
 }
 return "";
}

[[eraseable]]
float expr_evaluate(string s)
{
    float ret = false;
    if (str2chr(s, 0) == '+') {
        s = substring(s, 1, -1);
    } else if (str2chr(s, 0) == '-') {
        ret = true;
        s = substring(s, 1, -1);
    }
    float expr_fail = false;
    for (float i = 0, n = tokenize_console(s); i < n; ++i) {
        float o;
        string k, v;
        s = argv(i);
# 74 "./lib/cvar.qh"
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, ">=", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) >= stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "<=", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) <= stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, ">", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 1, -1); if (cvar(k) > stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "<", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 1, -1); if (cvar(k) < stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "==", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) == stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "!=", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 2, -1); if (cvar(k) != stof(v)) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "===", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 3, -1); if (cvar_string(k) == v) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        if ((o = strstrofs(s, "!==", 0)) >= 0) { k = substring(s, 0, o); v = substring(s, o + 3, -1); if (cvar_string(k) != v) continue; expr_fail = true; break;; };
        {
            k = s;
            float b = true;
            if (str2chr(k, 0) == '!') {
                k = substring(s, 1, -1);
                b = false;
            }
            float f = stof(k);
            float isnum = ftos(f) == k;
            if (((isnum ? f : cvar(k)) != 0) == b) continue; expr_fail = true; break;;
        }


    }
    if (!expr_fail) {
        ret = !ret;
    }

    return ret;
}

 void Draw_CylindricLine(vector from, vector to, float thickness, string texture, float aspect, float shift, vector rgb, float theAlpha, float drawflag, vector vieworg)
 {



  vector axis, thickdir, A, B, C, D;
  float length_tex;

  axis = normalize(to - from);
  length_tex = aspect * vlen(to - from) / thickness;


  thickdir = normalize(((axis) >< (vieworg - from)));

  A = from - thickdir * (thickness / 2);
  B = from + thickdir * (thickness / 2);
  C = to + thickdir * (thickness / 2);
  D = to - thickdir * (thickness / 2);

  R_BeginPolygon(texture, drawflag, false);
  R_PolygonVertex(A, '0 0 0' + shift * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(B, '0 1 0' + shift * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(C, '0 1 0' + (shift + length_tex) * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_PolygonVertex(D, '0 0 0' + (shift + length_tex) * '1 0 0', rgb, theAlpha);
  R_EndPolygon();
 }

            break;

            string esc;
            switch (str2chr(_json_s, _json_i++)) {
                default:
                    goto fail;
                case '"': esc = "\""; break;
                case '\\': esc = "\\"; break;

                case 'u': esc = "\\u"; break;
                case '/': esc = "/"; break;
            }

        }

[[eraseable]]
float json_parse(string in, float() func) {
    string trimmed = "";
    :trim {
        float o = strstrofs(in, "\"", 0);
        if (o >= 0) {
            string part = substring(in, 0, o + 1); in = substring(in, o + 1, -1);
            part = strreplace(" ", "", part);
            part = strreplace("\n", "", part);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim_str;
        } else {
            string part = in;
            part = strreplace(" ", "", part);
            part = strreplace("\n", "", part);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto done;
        }
    }
    :trim_str {
        float o = strstrofs(in, "\"", 0);
        float esc = strstrofs(in, "\\\"", 0);
        if (o < esc || esc < 0) {

            string part = substring(in, 0, o + 1); in = substring(in, o + 1, -1);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim;
        } else {

            string part = substring(in, 0, esc + 2); in = substring(in, esc + 2, -1);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim_str;
        }
    }
    :done;

    if(1){ _json_s = trimmed; _json_i = 0; }else voidfunc();
    _json_buffer = buf_create();
    float ret = func();
    if (!ret) {
        buf_del(_json_buffer);
        _json_buffer = -1;
    }
    return _json_buffer;
}

[[eraseable]]
string json_get(float buf, string key)
{
    for (float i = 1, n = buf_getsize(buf); i < n; i += 2) {
        if (bufstr_get(buf, i) == key) return bufstr_get(buf, i + 1);
    }
    return nil;
}

    buf_del(buf);
}

    }
}

[[eraseable]]
void mean_accumulate(entity e, .float a, .float c, float mean, float value, float weight)
{
 if (weight == 0) return;
 if (mean == 0) e.(a) *= (value ** weight);
 else e.(a) += (value ** mean) * weight;
 e.(c) += weight;
}

[[eraseable]]
float mean_evaluate(entity e, .float a, .float c, float mean)
{
 if (e.(c) == 0) return 0;
 if (mean == 0) return (e.(a) ** (1.0 / e.(c)));
 else return ((e.(a) / e.(c)) ** (1.0 / mean));
}

[[eraseable]]
float angc(float a1, float a2)
{
 while (a1 > 180)
  a1 -= 360;
 while (a1 < -179)
  a1 += 360;
 while (a2 > 180)
  a2 -= 360;
 while (a2 < -179)
  a2 += 360;
 float a = a1 - a2;
 while (a > 180)
  a -= 360;
 while (a < -179)
  a += 360;
 return a;
}

[[eraseable]]
float lerpratio(float f0, float f1, float ratio)
{

}

[[eraseable]]
float lerp(float t0, float f0, float t1, float f1, float t)
{
 return lerpratio(f0, f1, (t - t0) / (t1 - t0));
}

[[eraseable]]
float lerp3ratio(float f0, float f1, float f2, float ratio)
{
 float mid = 0.5;
 return ratio < mid ? lerpratio(f0, f1, ratio / mid) : ratio > mid ? lerpratio(f1, f2, (ratio - mid) / mid) : f1;
}

}

[[eraseable]]
vector lerpv(float t0, vector v0, float t1, vector v1, float t)
{
 return v0 + (v1 - v0) * ((t - t0) / (t1 - t0));
}

[[eraseable]]
vector bezier_quadratic_getpoint(vector a, vector b, vector c, float t)
{
 return (c - 2 * b + a) * (t * t)
        + (b - a) * (2 * t)
        + a;
}

[[eraseable]]

{
 return (c - 2 * b + a) * (2 * t)
        + (b - a) * 2;
}

         ) * spd + startspeedfactor
        ) * spd;

[[eraseable]]
float median(float a, float b, float c)
{
 return (a < c) ? bound(a, b, c) : bound(c, b, a);
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_equals(float a, float b)
{
 float eps = (max(a, -a) + max(b, -b)) * 0.001;
 return a - b < eps && b - a < eps;
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_equals_eps(float a, float b, float times_eps)
{
 float eps = max(fabs(a), fabs(b)) * FLOAT_EPSILON * times_eps;
 return a - b < eps && b - a < eps;
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_in_bounds(float a, float b, float c)
{
 float eps = (max(a, -a) + max(c, -c)) * 0.001;
 if (a > c) eps = -eps;
 return b == median(a - eps, b, c + eps);
}

[[eraseable]]
float ExponentialFalloff(float mindist, float maxdist, float halflifedist, float d)
{
 if (halflifedist > 0) return (0.5 ** ((bound(mindist, d, maxdist) - mindist) / halflifedist));
 else if (halflifedist < 0) return (0.5 ** ((bound(mindist, d, maxdist) - maxdist) / halflifedist));
 else return 1;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector solve_quadratic(float a, float b, float c)
{
 vector v;
 float D;
 v = '0 0 0';
 if (a == 0)
 {
  if (b != 0)
  {
   v.x = v.y = -c / b;
   v.z = 1;
  }
  else
  {
   if (c == 0)
   {

    v.z = 1;
   }
  }
 }
 else
 {
  D = b * b - 4 * a * c;
  if (D >= 0)
  {
   D = sqrt(D);
   if (a > 0)
   {
    v.x = ((-b) - D) / (2 * a);
    v.y = ((-b) + D) / (2 * a);
   }
   else
   {
    v.x = (-b + D) / (2 * a);
    v.y = (-b - D) / (2 * a);
   }
   v.z = 1;
  }
  else
  {

   D = sqrt(-D);
   v.x = -b / (2 * a);
   if (a > 0) v.y = D / (2 * a);
   else v.y = -D / (2 * a);
   v.z = 0;
  }
 }
 return v;
}







[[eraseable]]
float map_ranges(float value, float src_min, float src_max, float dest_min, float dest_max) {
 float src_diff = src_max - src_min;
 float dest_diff = dest_max - dest_min;
 float ratio = (value - src_min) / src_diff;
 return dest_min + dest_diff * ratio;
}


[[eraseable]]
float map_bound_ranges(float value, float src_min, float src_max, float dest_min, float dest_max) {
 if (value <= src_min) return dest_min;
 if (value >= src_max) return dest_max;
 return map_ranges(value, src_min, src_max, dest_min, dest_max);
}

[[eraseable]]
float Noise_Brown(entity e, float dt)
{
 e.noise_baccum += random() * sqrt(dt);
 return e.noise_baccum;
}
[[eraseable]]
float Noise_Pink(entity e, float dt)
{
 float f;
 f = dt * 60;

 if (random() > (0.3190 ** f)) e.noise_paccum = 0.34848 * (2 * random() - 1);
 if (random() > (0.7756 ** f)) e.noise_paccum2 = 0.28768 * (2 * random() - 1);
 if (random() > (0.9613 ** f)) e.noise_paccum3 = 0.43488 * (2 * random() - 1);
 return e.noise_paccum + e.noise_paccum2 + e.noise_paccum3;
}
[[eraseable]]
float Noise_White(entity e, float dt)
{
 return random() * 2 - 1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float Noise_Burst(entity e, float dt, float p)
{
 if (random() > (p ** dt)) e.noise_bstate = !e.noise_bstate;
 return 2 * e.noise_bstate - 1;
}

{

 vector e = vec_to_max(a, b);

}

 vector e = vec_to_min(a, b);

 return c;
}

[[eraseable]]
float angle_snap_f(float f, float increment)
{
 for (float j = 0; j <= 360; )
 {
  if (f <= j - increment) return j - increment;
  j = j + increment;
 }

 return 0;
}

 return c;
}

{

 {

  e.url_rbufpos += 1;
  return s;
 }
 else if (e.url_fh == URL_FH_STDOUT)

  return nil;
 }
 else
 {

  return fgets(e.url_fh);
 }
}

            break;
        case "join":
            string s = substring(command, argv_start_index(2), -1);
            if (s != matrix_room && matrix_room != "") {
                MX_Leave(matrix_room);
                strunzone(matrix_room);
            }
            matrix_room = strzone(s);
            MX_Join(matrix_room);
            break;
        case "sync":
            MX_Sync(nil);
            break;
        case "typing":
            MX_Typing(true);
            break;
        case "say":
            MX_Say(substring(command, argv_start_index(2), -1));
            break;
        case "leave":
            MX_Leave(matrix_room);
            matrix_room = nil;
            break;
        case "forget":
            MX_Forget(matrix_room);
            matrix_room = "";
            break;
    }
}

string Team_ColorCode(float teamid)
{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return COL_TEAM_1;
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return COL_TEAM_2;
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return COL_TEAM_3;
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return COL_TEAM_4;
 }

 return "^7";
}

vector Team_ColorRGB(float teamid)
{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return '1 0.0625 0.0625';
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return '0.0625 0.0625 1';
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return '1 1 0.0625';
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return '1 0.0625 1';
 }

 return '0 0 0';
}

{
 switch(teamid)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return CTX(_("TEAM^Red"));
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return CTX(_("TEAM^Blue"));
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return CTX(_("TEAM^Yellow"));
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return CTX(_("TEAM^Pink"));
 }

 return _("Neutral");
}

float Team_ColorToTeam(string team_color)
{
 switch(strtolower(team_color))
 {
  case "red": return NUM_TEAM_1;
  case "blue": return NUM_TEAM_2;
  case "yellow": return NUM_TEAM_3;
  case "pink": return NUM_TEAM_4;
  case "auto": return 0;
 }

 return -1;
}




float Team_IsValidTeam(float team_num)
{
 switch (team_num)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1:
  case NUM_TEAM_2:
  case NUM_TEAM_3:
  case NUM_TEAM_4:
  {
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}




float Team_IsValidIndex(float index)
{
 switch (index)
 {
  case 1:
  case 2:
  case 3:
  case 4:
  {
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}




float Team_IndexToTeam(float index)
{
 switch (index)
 {
  case 1: return NUM_TEAM_1;
  case 2: return NUM_TEAM_2;
  case 3: return NUM_TEAM_3;
  case 4: return NUM_TEAM_4;
 }
 return -1;
}




float Team_TeamToIndex(float team_num)
{
 switch (team_num)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return 1;
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return 2;
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return 3;
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return 4;
 }
 return -1;
}




float Team_TeamToBit(float team_num)
{
 if (!Team_IsValidTeam(team_num))
 {
  return 0;
 }
 return (1 << (Team_TeamToIndex(team_num) - 1));
}




float Team_IndexToBit(float index)
{
 return (1 << (index - 1));
}

entity EFFECT_VAPORIZER(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_NEUTRAL;
    }
}
entity EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

entity EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER(float teamid)
{
    entity e;
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_RED; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_BLUE; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_YELLOW; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_PINK; break;
        default: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_NEUTRAL; break;
    }
    if (_particleeffectnum(e.eent_eff_name) < 0 || !Team_IsValidTeam(teamid)) { e = EFFECT_TR_NEXUIZPLASMA; }
    return e;
}

# 6 "./client/hud/panel/../panel.qh" 2
# 3 "./client/hud/panel/modicons.qh" 2

float autocvar_hud_panel_modicons;
float autocvar_hud_panel_modicons_dynamichud = true;

float mod_active;
# 7 "common/gamemodes/gamemode/payload/cl_payload.qc" 2

void HUD_Mod_Payload_Export(float fh)
{
 fputs(fh, strcat("seta ", "hud_panel_modicons_payload_layout", " \"", cvar_string("hud_panel_modicons_payload_layout"), "\"\n"));
}

float autocvar_hud_panel_modicons_payload_layout;

void HUD_Mod_Payload(vector myPos, vector mySize)
{
 mod_active = 1;

 float progress = bound(0, (0, g_stat_PAYLOAD_PROGRESS), 1);
 float spd = (0, g_stat_PAYLOAD_SPEED);
 float push = (0, g_stat_PAYLOAD_PUSH_PACKED);
 float goals = (0, g_stat_PAYLOAD_GOALS_PACKED);

 float barh = mySize.y * 0.34;
 vector barPos = myPos + (_vec2_x = (0), _vec2_y = ((mySize.y - barh) * 0.5), _vec2);
 vector barSize = (_vec2_x = (mySize.x), _vec2_y = (barh), _vec2);

 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(barPos), HUD_Scale(barSize), '0.1 0.1 0.1', panel_fg_alpha * 0.5, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 for(float j = 1; j <= NUM_TEAMS; ++j)
 {
  float f = ((goals >> ((j - 1) * PLC_PUSH_BITS)) & PLC_PUSH_MASK) / PLC_PUSH_MASK;
  float w = payload_unpack_push(push, j);
  vector col = Team_ColorRGB(Team_IndexToTeam(j));
  drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(barPos + (_vec2_x = (f * barSize.x - barSize.y * 0.1), _vec2_y = (0), _vec2)), HUD_Scale((_vec2_x = (barSize.y * 0.2), _vec2_y = (barSize.y), _vec2)), col, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
  if(w > 0)
   drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(barPos + (_vec2_x = (f * barSize.x - barSize.y * 0.1), _vec2_y = (-barSize.y * 0.5), _vec2)), HUD_Scale((_vec2_x = (barSize.y * 0.2), _vec2_y = (barSize.y * 0.4 * min(1, w)), _vec2)), col, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_ADDITIVE);
 }

 vector cartCol = (spd == 0) ? '0.6 0.6 0.6' : '1 0.8 0.2';
 drawfill_builtin(HUD_Shift(barPos + (_vec2_x = (progress * barSize.x - barSize.y * 0.25), _vec2_y = (-barSize.y * 0.15), _vec2)), HUD_Scale((_vec2_x = (barSize.y * 0.5), _vec2_y = (barSize.y * 1.3), _vec2)), cartCol, panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);

 if(autocvar_hud_panel_modicons_payload_layout)
  drawstring_aspect(myPos, strcat(ftos(floor(progress * 100 + 0.5)), "%"), (_vec2_x = (mySize.x * 0.25), _vec2_y = (mySize.y * 0.3), _vec2), '1 1 1', panel_fg_alpha, DRAWFLAG_NORMAL);
}
